Shanghai Municipal Police.
C. I. S.
I. O. REG
No. 696
3/11/16
Y - Poo Station.
3rd Nov 1916
REPORT ON Revolutionists detained & charged
Made by Insptr. Johnston Forwarded by

Sir
I beg to report with reference to report on M.P.S.
of the 30th ult., King-ching Young, Ding Kwai Jan,
Li Sung Sai, Ng. Kwe Ching, Zang Sung Mai and
You Your San, brought to the Y-Poo Station a
man named Mr Young Paw, The whole of these
men were formerly rebels during the last revolution
and were disbanded a short while ago, The Chinese
Government paid them $280 to divide amongst
16 men he gave the above named $4 each.
You. Your. San is in the employ of the Arsenal stated
that he wished the man Mr. detained & he would
return at 10 Am next morning with a warrant -
As the warrant was not forthcoming they were
taken before the M.C on the 31st and a remand
was ordered until the 2nd inst., The Case was
dismissed Complaining stated as the accused
were from their own province they did not wish
to proceed with the Case.

Cop:
Keep this statement on file . It
may be of use later for reference.
3/11/16.
K.M.
Cop

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
C. I. S.
I. O. REG
第 696 号
1916年11月3日
杨树浦巡捕房。
1916年11月3日

关于被拘留并被指控的革命党人的报告
由约翰斯顿（Johnston）巡官呈报

先生：
谨就上月30日关于M.P.S.的报告呈报如下：杨金庆（King-ching Young）、丁桂珍（Ding Kwai Jan）、李松赛（Li Sung Sai）、吴贵清（Ng. Kwe Ching）、张松梅（Zang Sung Mai）及尤友三（You Your San），将一名名为杨鲍（Young Paw，音译）的男子带至杨树浦巡捕房。上述人员均在上一场革命期间曾是叛乱分子，并于不久前被遣散。中国政府支付了280元供16人分配，他给予上述每人4元。
尤友三受雇于兵工厂，称希望将该男子杨鲍拘留，并表示将于次日上午10时携带逮捕令返回。由于逮捕令未至，他们于31日被提解至会审公廨（M.C.），并获准还押至本月2日。案件随后被驳回，原告方称因被告均系其同省人士，故不愿继续诉讼。

副本：
将此陈述存档。日后或可供参考之用。
1916年11月3日。
K.M.
副本

Form 71

STATEMENT.
DETECTIVE DEPARTMENT.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
1st November 1916
Yangtse Rd. Station

Statement made by Woo Leung Poo

My name is Woo Leung Poo. I am 43 years old and a
native of Honan. my home is at 1116A Clarendon Road.
I am a follower of Dr Sun Yat sen. I came to
Shanghai in April 1913, in June 1913 I went to
Nanking and was a soldier in the army of Gen. Sun
and was sent to defend Nanking, and took part
in the defence of Nanking, which was captured
by General Chan Hsun in August 1913. I fled from
that city and came to Shanghai, since then I
have been unemployed, I occasionally receive money
from General Kwong Hsin sometimes $50- and sometimes
$100 or more. In July this year I started to
recruit soldiers for a rebellion and recruited 16
because I thought that the rebellion, then going
on in Yunnan and other Provinces would extend
to Shanghai and in such a case I would
command 10000 soldiers under Lan Tung Fong. These
soldiers are now under Yang Hon J.k. They are distributed
in Wosung, Kotang,
Tsa-Dung, Nanwan, and various places in the
Provinces of Kiangsu. On the 28th of October
1916 I received $250 from General Yang Hon J.k
to distribute among the 16 men that I
had recruited, after deducting $50 for my own
expenses I divided the remainder
among the men. I did not share the money equally owing
to some of the men going away from Shanghai
and I thought it right to pay their expenses
Kong Ching Tsang, Dong Wan Ho,

1916年11月1日
南京路巡捕房

伍良甫（Woo Leung Poo）所作陈述

本人名叫伍良甫。现年43岁，籍贯河南。寓所位于克拉伦登路1116A号。
本人是孙中山博士的追随者。本人于1913年4月抵达上海，1913年6月前往南京，在孙将军麾下担任士兵，并被派往保卫南京，参与了南京保卫战，该城于1913年8月被张勋将军攻陷。本人逃离该城来到上海，此后一直失业。本人偶尔从广信将军（General Kwong Hsin，音译）处收到款项，有时50元，有时100元或更多。今年7月，本人开始为叛乱招募士兵，共招募16人，因为本人认为当时在云南及其他省份进行的叛乱将蔓延至上海，若发生此种情况，本人将在蓝腾凤（Lan Tung Fong，音译）麾下指挥一万名士兵。这些士兵目前归杨汉杰（Yang Hon J.k.，音译）管辖。他们分布在吴淞、高塘（Kotang，音译）、曹东（Tsa-Dung，音译）、南湾（Nanwan，音译）以及江苏省各地。1916年10月28日，本人从杨汉杰将军处收到250元，用于分发给本人招募的16名士兵，扣除50元作为本人开销后，将其余款项分发给众人。由于部分人员离开上海，本人并未平均分配这笔钱，且本人认为支付他们的路费是合理的。
孔庆藏（Kong Ching Tsang，音译）、董万和（Dong Wan Ho，音译），
